command:
set -euo pipefail; STERN="$HOME/.claude/star/stern.py"; UNIT=frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service; TARGET="$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_777_runtime.py"; echo '=== PRECONDITION ==='; status_json="$(python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status)"; printf '%s
' "$status_json"; aktiv="$(printf '%s' "$status_json" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(str(bool(json.load(sys.stdin).get("aktiv"))).lower())')"; if [ "$aktiv" != false ]; then echo 'REFUSED: gespraech.aktiv is not false' >&2; exit 20; fi; effective="$(systemctl --user show "$UNIT" -p ExecStart --value)"; printf 'EFFECTIVE_BEFORE=%s
' "$effective"; case "$effective" in *"$TARGET"*) ;; *) echo 'REFUSED: loaded ExecStart is not voice_777_runtime.py' >&2; exit 21;; esac; oldpid="$(systemctl --user show "$UNIT" -p MainPID --value)"; printf 'OLD_PID=%s
' "$oldpid"; if [ "${oldpid:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ -r "/proc/$oldpid/cmdline" ]; then printf 'OLD_CMD='; tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$oldpid/cmdline"; echo; fi; echo '=== CONTROLLED RESTART ==='; systemctl --user restart "$UNIT"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do state="$(systemctl --user is-active "$UNIT" 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ "$state" = active ] && break; sleep 1; done; state="$(systemctl --user is-active "$UNIT" 2>/dev/null || true)"; [ "$state" = active ] || { echo "FAIL: unit state=$state" >&2; exit 22; }; newpid="$(systemctl --user show "$UNIT" -p MainPID --value)"; printf 'NEW_PID=%s
' "$newpid"; [ "${newpid:-0}" -gt 0 ] || { echo 'FAIL: no MainPID' >&2; exit 23; }; printf 'NEW_CMD='; tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$newpid/cmdline"; echo; cmd="$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$newpid/cmdline")"; case "$cmd" in *voice_777_runtime.py*) ;; *) echo 'FAIL: live MainPID is not OMEGA 777 voice wrapper' >&2; exit 24;; esac; echo '=== POST ==='; systemctl --user show "$UNIT" -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager; python3 "$STERN" gespraech-status; echo OMEGA_VOICE_777_ACTIVATED=1
